title: observability.slo.burned v1 data
description: An SLO error budget is burning fast enough to need attention. Evolved additively within v1: new OPTIONAL fields only. A new required field, a removed field or a retyped field is a v2.

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace the object lives in.

burnRate.description: Observed burn rate as a multiple of the budget-neutral rate. 1.0 exhausts the budget exactly at the end of the SLO period.

threshold.description: Burn rate that triggered this event, so a consumer need not know the alerting rules to render severity.

budgetRemaining.description: Fraction of the error budget left, 0..1.
